text:
Maria Lopez: heads up — demo workload for Q3 needs a short-term burst plan in eu-west1 and us-west2, and we need quota increases on GPUs and ENIs. can we coordinate?
Samir Patel: rough numbers? how many GPUs and what types?
Maria Lopez: target peak = 60 concurrent workers. pref A100s (40) + H100s fallback (20) for latency-sensitive paths. also need extra ENIs for per-pod networking — estimate +120 ENIs across the two regions.
Jing Wu: noted. current per-project GPU quota in eu-west1 is 16 A100 and us-west2 is 24. ENI quota more restrictive in us-west2 (50 left).
Theo Barnes: we should try to avoid doubling reserved spend. suggestion: request quota increases for steady baseline (30 A100s) and use a short-lived reserved burst for the remaining 30 via Dedicated burst pool + spot fallback. cheaper than full reserve.
Maria Lopez: yes — baseline 30 A100s reserved, plus 30 burstable (can be different family). need ACCT team to open quota cases for: GPUs (A100 & H100), regional vCPUs, and ENI increase.
Samir Patel: I can draft the justification. include workload profile (short sessions, 95th p99 token latency target 150ms), expected burst windows (demo dates: 2026-06-15 to 2026-06-20), and fallback plan to H100/spot.
Jing Wu: add network details: we’ll need /27 for worker subnets in both regions; request extra static EIPs for NATs (10 per region).
Theo Barnes: cost check — reserved baseline (30 A100) ~ $X/month; burst on Dedicated hourly commitments we can get on a 1-month promo. we should ask finance for temporary approval.
Maria Lopez: @infra-oncall can you create the cloud quota requests and track ticket IDs? please include cost justification snippet I’ll paste below.
infra-oncall: creating quota cases now. pinging cloud-provider support and accounts. will link tickets here when created.
Maria Lopez: cost justification (paste):
```
Workload: Q3 public demo traffic spike
Baseline: 30 A100 (reserved) to maintain p95 latency
Burst: up to +30 GPUs across eu-west1/us-west2 for demo days (non-continuous)
Fallback: use H100 spot pool and autoscale down after spike
Risk: without extra ENIs and GPUs demo capacity fails, potential SLA breach for pilot customers
```
Samir Patel: copying into support form. also adding fallback policy: if A100 unavailable then route to H100 with model-quant profile v2.
Jing Wu: quota-bot: Request created: CLOUD-98721 for GPUs (eu-west1), CLOUD-98722 for GPUs (us-west2), CLOUD-98723 for ENIs and vCPUs. ETA support response 48-72h.
quota-bot: Please ensure billing contact is set for the account. missing cost center delays approvals.
Maria Lopez: I updated billing contact to infra-team@redwood.com and added finance approver Theo.
Theo Barnes: finance acked provisional approval for up-to-$Y for the demo week. will formalize if cloud quotes exceed estimate.
Samir Patel: infra checklist to close: 1) open quota tickets (done), 2) reserve baseline Dedicated pool (apply for temp commit), 3) allocate subnet/EIP changes (network team), 4) create autoscale + fallback routing (serving runtime).
Maria Lopez: can someone pick 2) reserve baseline? I can handle 4).
Theo Barnes: I’ll lead reservation request with cloud sales — have contact.
Jing Wu: network team — please confirm /27 availability in both regions and open ticket if not.
infra-oncall: tickets linked: CLOUD-98721, CLOUD-98722, CLOUD-98723. monitoring alert set to detect ENI exhaustion and GPU capacity errors; will escalate to oncall.
Maria Lopez: thanks — I’ll schedule a short sync Mon 09:30 PT to confirm progress and rollback plan.
Samir Patel: sounds good. adding meeting invite and brief runbook for the demo failover. :white_check_mark:
Theo Barnes: one last note — if cloud denies ENI raise, fallback is to consolidate workers behind fewer nodes and use secondary NAT; latency may degrade but demo still possible. include that in runbook.
Maria Lopez: agreed. will add fallback notes and keep thread updated. :rocket:
